chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a matter, but he refused and withheld, then said: 'If We were to give you everything you want, it would be evil for you, and the one with this matter would be seized by the neck.'

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The Wilayah of Allah was kept secret by Him to Jibraeel (peace be upon him), and Jibraeel kept it secret to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and Muhammad kept it secret to Ali (peace be upon him), and Ali kept it secret to whoever Allah willed. Then you broadcast it. Who is the one who withheld even a single word he heard?'

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'In the wisdom of the progeny of Dawud (peace be upon him), it is befitting for the Muslim to be master of himself, focused on his affairs, and knowing the people of his time. So fear Allah and do not broadcast our hadith. If it were not for Allah defending His friends and exacting retribution for His friends from their enemies...'

...have you not seen what Allah did with the progeny of Barmak, and what Allah exacted for Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)? And the Banu Al-Ash'ath were upon great danger, so Allah defended them through their Wilayah for Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

And you are in Iraq, seeing the deeds of these Pharaohs, and what Allah has granted them respite. So upon you is Taqwa of Allah, and let not the worldly life deceive you, nor be deceived by the one who has been granted respite, for it is as if the Matter (of the Qaim) has arrived to you.

key_terms.الْأَمْر: The Matter (referring to the rise of the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of concealing knowledge and the Wilayah of the Imams according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) elucidates the wisdom of *kitman* (concealment) by contrasting the Prophet's silence with the companions' broadcasting of knowledge, citing the Banu Al-Ash'ath's deliverance from danger through their Wilayah of Imam Al-Hasan as a precedent. He warns the people of Iraq about the tyrants (*al-fara'ina*) and the imminent arrival of the divine command, emphasizing that divine protection for the faithful often operates through hidden mechanisms rather than immediate public manifestation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> a question, but he<sup>asws</sup> refused (to answer) and withheld, then said: ‘If<sup>asws</sup> were to give you everything what you want, it would (bring about) evil to you and the one (found to be) with this matter would be seized by the neck.

Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘The Wilayah of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> was secrectly conveyed to Jibraeel<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, and Jibraeel<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> secretly conveyed it to Muhammad<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, and Muhammad<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> secretly conveyed it to Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, and Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> secretly conveyed it to whoever Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so Desired it (to be conveyed to). Then, you all are broadcasting that. Who is the one who has withheld (even) a single word which he heard?’

Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘In the wisdom of the progeny of Dawood<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> (it is), ‘it is befitting for the Muslim that he happens to be in control of himself, determined upon his affairs, recognising the people of his time period. Therefore fear Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and do not be broadcasting our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Ahadeeth, if not, Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Defend His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> friends and exact Retribution fromHis<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> enemies.

Have you not seen what Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Did with the progeny of Barmak and what Retribution Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Exacted for Abu Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>? And it was so that the Clan of Al-Ash’as was upon a great danger, so Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Defended them due to their Wilayah for Abu Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>.

And you all are in Al-Iraq. You are seeing the deeds of these Pharaohs (tyrants), and what Respite Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has for them. Therefore, it is upon you with the fearing of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, and neither be deceived by the life of the world nor deceived by the one who has Respite for him, for it is as if the matter (Rising of Al-Qaim<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>) have (almost) arrived to you’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr who has said the following:

“Once I asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) a question. He refrained silently and said, ‘If we give you everything you want, it may become evil for you and the neck of the owner of this cause will be caught tight.’

“Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘It is the guardianship of Allah, Who told it secretly to Jibril, who secretly told it to Muhammad (a.s.) who secretly told it to Ali (a.s.) who secretly told it to whoever Allah wanted and then you publicize it. Who is he that has heard a word then has held it secretly?’

“Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘It is in the wisdom of ‘Ale Dawud (family of David), “It is necessary for a Muslim to have control over his soul, be attentive to his affairs and have foil knowledge of the people of his time.” Be pious before Allah and do not publicize our Hadith. It is a fact that Allah defends his friends and exacts recompense for His friends from His enemies.

Have you considered how Allah dealt with Ale Barmak (family of Barmak) and how He recompensed for abu al-Hassan (a.s.) when banu ‘Ash’ath faced the great danger and Allah defended them for their supporting abu al- Hassan, recipient of divine supreme covenant?

In Iraq you are well aware of the deeds of those Pharaohs and the respite that Allah has given them. Therefore, you must observe piety before Allah and do not allow the worldly life to deceive you. Do not be confused about those who have been given respite. It is as if the matter (reappearance of al-Mahdi, recipient of divine supreme covenant) is almost within your reach.’”
